blocks.content: Write a program to add elements to a list.

items: Get three string inputs for the variables input1, input2, input3.
Declare a string list called musicians.
Add input1 and input2 to the back of the list.
Then, add input3 to the front of the list.

blocks.content: Hint: Use push_back() to add elements to the end and push_front() functions to add them to the start of the list.

Test Inputinput1 = Neil
input2 = John
input3 = Keith
